events.title: Exploring Innovations and Opportunities with AI Agents in Copilot studio
events.description:
1. AI agents – core concepts
AI agents were discussed as systems that combine: LLMs (models) for reasoning and responses
Prompt instructions to guide behaviour
Knowledge sources to ground answers
Tools / connectors (MCP) to perform actions
The difference between simple chatbots and action-capable agents was emphasised, with agents being able to interact with emails, calendars, files, Excel, and workflows.
2. Prompting: System prompt vs User prompt
A clear distinction was explained: System prompt: defines the agent’s role, rules, boundaries, tone, and behaviour.
User prompt: the end-user’s input or request during interaction.
Proper system prompts help reduce ambiguity, improve consistency, and optimise token usage.
Participants asked practical questions about modifying prompts and how memory/history impacts responses.
3. Copilot Studio walkthrough (conceptual + demo-driven)
Copilot Studio was presented as the central platform to: Create agents from scratch or guided flows
Select and configure models
Add knowledge sources (files, SharePoint, web, databases)
Add tools/connectors (Outlook, Excel, Calendar, workflows)
Test agents before publishing

events.title: Azure Cloud, Azure DevOps & Azure Data
events.description: Abstract: Continuous Delivery As A Service (CDaaS) using Azure Cloud, Azure DevOps, Github and Deployment to a Kubernetes Cluster It is now 2020 and good DevOps practices are no longer just nice to have. It is absolutely necessary to continuously deliver value to our end users. Yet this isn't easy to do right. Unfortunately, all the flashy Hello World DevOps demos we see at conferences don’t really help us figure out how to do DevOps in the real world. They don’t even let us know what is possible. In this session, we change all of that. We explore the why's and the how. Why is DevOps important? Why do we care? How do we implement DevOps best practices? And finally, we will do a real world deep dive. Starting from nothing at all except source code (and I mean NOTHING. No infrastructure at all) we end with a complex modern application deployed all the way out into production hosted in the cloud on a Kubernetes cluster. Speaker Hassan FADILI : MVP Anas BELABAS : MVP Said WAHID : Developer .Net MCT
